Brief Resume and Nature of Expertise in
Specific Functional Area

Ms. Trupti Kamlesh Patel holds Diploma in Civil Engineering from Gujarat Technology
University (GTU). She has worked as Architecture’s Guidance in private industry for 10 years.
She has also worked as Joint Treasurer of State Mahila Morcha, Secretary in DAMINI Women’s
Foundation (NGO) and Ex-observer in Human Rights Association for Protection, D.N.H &
Daman Diu. She is Paralegal Volunteer of State Legal Services Authority Daman. She has been
conducting social work for woman and child. Ms. Patel was on the Board of Directors of Bharat
Sanchar Nigam Limited as Independent Director from November, 2021 to November, 2024.
